components.purpose: The plain title for the page with one sentence of description underneath. Its guidance says it is a plain heading with optional subheading and description, with no image or buttons, and suits the top of a page.
The feature-by-feature comparison with competitors. Its guidance says it is for comparing our product with alternatives, with rows as content items.
The closing call to action to book a demo. Its guidance says it is a full-width band with heading, description and buttons, best placed near the end of a page.
